mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname FROM Author_Applications a JOIN integrated_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY a.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Author_Applications WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT a.*, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname FROM Author_Applications a JOIN integrated_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.application_id = #{applicationId}
SELECT a.*, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname FROM Author_Applications a JOIN integrated_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Author_Applications (user_id, pen_name, work_title, platform, description, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{penName}, #{workTitle}, #{platform}, #{description}, 'PENDING')
